component.name: Axionis Theme Manager
component.summary: Control the complete Cinnamon desktop appearance

description.p: Axionis Theme Manager applies trusted, declarative appearance bundles for Cinnamon, GTK and XApps. Bundles can include a desktop theme, application theme, icons, cursors, wallpaper, screen-lock styling and the preferred light or dark appearance.

The graphical component mixer can also combine any installed Cinnamon, GTK, icon and cursor themes with a wallpaper and appearance preferences. Theme imports reject executable content. Applying does not run scripts or require administrator privileges.
Add the complete graphical component mixer, selective bundle apply, installed-theme discovery and missing-reference validation.
